words.name: technique-effects
words.spec: A technique's `effects` list may hold {"name": <library Effect name>, "unlock_layer": n, "passive_art": true, "rule": ...}. When a build knows the technique at layer n or above (fight.py `tech_layers`, the GDScript FighterCompiler), the loader adds that Effect from assets/data/combat_effects.json exactly as an item's named Effect is added (fight.py expand_library's add_library_effect, with its counters). Today expand_library reads only `passives`, so a passive art (an Effect-backed art that takes no art slot) never reaches the fight. export_techniques.py should carry the field into items_cong_phap.json, and sect_fight.py's effect_names should list it.
words.gdd_text: Công Pháp rule (passive arts): a technique may carry passive arts, each a named Effect with an unlock layer. Known to that layer, the passive art's Effect is always on in a fight; it takes no art slot and is never fired.
used_by: The Pole Draws from the Vein
words.decision_reason: checkpoint 2026-11-27: passive arts are written in about 20 owners' technique files (chan_kim, coc_vu, lac_ha, thuy_vi, vu_an, ...), so every later pass needs the loader to attach a technique's Effects by layer; no existing word does it (passives carry only plain stat lines). The Pole Draws keeps its record in the Effects file and runs once the loader attaches it.

words.name: darkness-element
words.spec: Darkness (Hán-Việt am) as an engine element: debuff (and buff) stack piles `dark` in combat_engine.json BUFF and DEBUFF, the readables own/foe.debuff.dark, the filter element `dark`, and the scope tag `am` in CHARACTER_MODS scope_element. Its stack effect (what a Darkness stack does, Effects Formulas D) needs a ruling first: proposed, each Darkness stack on a foe lowers its healing taken by 2 % (light-drinking iron), with no cap, decaying with the batch. Until then the scope tag `am` reaches no art (gap report line on tx-iron-horse-banner).
words.gdd_text: Effects Formulas D, Darkness (Ám): each Darkness debuff stack lowers the holder's healing taken by 2 %; Darkness stacks are laid by Darkness arts and Effects and last their batch.
words.decision_reason: checkpoint 2026-11-27: a whole new element (piles, readables, scope, and a stack effect that needs the user's ruling) for one Effect on a lost item with no holder. The Banner Is Raised stays not_run in the Effects file; the full record waits here. Darkness also appears in thu_phan, hong_dau and nam_pho: if one of those passes needs it, build it then, after the stack-effect ruling.

words.name: curse-fast
words.spec: The mod flag `curse_fast` (1 or more while it holds): a curse status its holder lays while the flag holds cannot be removed by the target's cleanses (cleanse with `status` or `curses`, and the build's cleanse field) until it ends on time. Mirrors `talisman_fast`, which does the same for talisman-marked stack batches.
words.gdd_text: Effects rule 6, mod `curse_fast`: while it holds, the curses you lay cannot be cleansed; they end only on time.
words.decision_reason: checkpoint 2026-11-27: it has a real holder (Phương Trực Ngôn, the Nguyên Anh Chief Judge, whose build is seal-and-curse and who wears the Bridge Court Pair), it is half of a set bonus as written, and it is small: the curse-status twin of talisman_fast, one flag checked in the cleanse path of each engine. No existing word holds a curse status through a cleanse (talisman_fast and protect hold stack batches only). Other owners' 'cannot be cleansed' texts are talisman stacks (hoa_tinh, already talisman_fast) or a self-poison (hoa_cai), so this rests on Sentence Stands alone. Swap in the pending Sentence Stands record once built.

words.name: curse-reflect
words.spec: The mod `curse_reflect` (a count of charges, timed with `for` or for the fight, as `soul_reflect`): the next curse status that would land on you does not land, a charge is spent, and the same curse (its stacks and duration) is laid on its caster instead, as yours. Raises `curse_reflected {status}` on the reflector.
words.gdd_text: Effects rule 6, mod `curse_reflect`: each charge turns the next curse that would land on you back on its caster.
words.decision_reason: checkpoint 2026-11-27: a new redirect in both engines' status code for one half of one Effect, held by a Trúc Cơ copyist who is no fighter, and no other owner's text asks for a curse reflect. No existing word fits: the engine raises no event on the side a curse lands on (status_applied goes to the caster), and move_own_debuffs moves every batch, not the one curse. A Fair Copy keeps its soul half (soul_reflect) and marks the curse half as not run.

Sentence Stands.rule: Bridge Court Pair, full set (2 pieces): a curse you lay on a foe who carries your Weight (an Earth stack) cannot be cleansed and lasts 2 s longer (status duration +50 % for curses, about 2 s on the 4 s curses; the 5 s clamp holds).
